notes: «جميعا عن غندر» is where the three heads meet, so the names after it are the shared tail.
«قال ابن المثنى حدثنا محمد بن جعفر» names the teacher with his full name in Ibn al-Muthanna's version: a variant group, since Ghundar and Muhammad b. Ja'far are not merged here.
«قال عمران فلا أدري» is Imran's doubt about the Prophet's words; it is not a link.
